_comment: The project profile: what kind of product this is. discipline lenses turns it into the review lenses (show / apply / check). Fill it from the bootstrap questions; allowed values are listed in discipline lenses. Re-run `discipline lenses apply` whenever it changes. 'specRules' is null, or switches on the gate check that every business rule in the spec is pinned by a test (see discipline spec-rules). 'ai' lists how the product uses models (rag, assistive, agentic; [] for none); with any mode, 'aiEvals' says where prompts and their eval sets live (see discipline ai-evals). 'decisionsElsewhere' lists folders of decisions recorded before discipline was adopted (e.g. ["docs/adr"]), which stay where they are and are searched too. 'overrides' turns a lens on or off by hand, with the reason. 'customLenses' adds the project's own lenses, {name: {checklist, why, secondOpinion?}}: create one with `discipline lenses new`.
product: <PROJECT>: one line on what it is and who it is for
data: <PROJECT>: the sensitive data it holds (personal data, payments, health, several tenants), or none
